reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text directly supports it: §2.1 states 'No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies' and that declining to place further orders is 'not a breach or shortfall', which meets the preferred position (fees for ordered services only).

Supporting provisions corroborate: §7.1 bars undisclosed minimum-use charges, §12.3 confirms no minimum-volume commitment, and §9.4 gives termination for convenience with refund of prepaid Fees — so no take-or-pay, shortfall penalty, or volume cap on Customer usage exists.

Redline is unchanged and no counterparty comment is present, which is correct for a compliant finding; the rationale appropriately notes §7.7 late-payment liquidated damages falls outside this rule's scope.
No deterministic check failures; nothing in the supplied paragraphs contradicts the compliance conclusion.
